deliverables: WP 1: community-facing technical coordination, including technical expert attendance at major ecosystem events and commissioned technical reports.
WP 2: protocol governance and evolution support for the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group.
WP 3: establishment of a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027.
request.recipient: Intersect on behalf of the vendor, with funds directed to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect Technical Steering Committee Support for 12 months across community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review.

claims.claim: The proposal requests $298,250, stated as 1,193,000 ADA, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
The budget is divided into 256,000 ADA for WP 1, 832,000 ADA for WP 2, and 105,000 ADA for WP 3.
The work packages cover community-facing technical coordination, protocol governance and evolution, and a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal states that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the withdrawal does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.

Intersect states the Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding in the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Treasury administration will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, external oversight entities, and published multisignature permission thresholds.

summary: The document presents a 1,193,000 ADA, 12-month TSC support request with work-package budgeting, governance-process references, NCL and prior-funding disclosures, smart-contract custody details, and oversight assertions, while making execution contingent on IntersectMBO budget approval.
